<document id=DOC_req_open_enum>
Required: PostgreSQL, Redis or similar databases.
</document>

State whether the candidate meets the requirement above, and say whether
you matched a named item or judged something equivalent.

response.text:
The candidate **meets the requirement**. 

This was determined by **judging something equivalent**: MySQL is not one of the explicitly named items (PostgreSQL or Redis), but it qualifies as a "similar database" (specifically, an open-source relational database similar to PostgreSQL).
